description: CompSniper shows what items have actually sold for on eBay. Ask about any product and get recent completed sales with sold price, shipping, condition and sale date, plus a price summary: median, typical range and number of sales. Results filter out accessories and mismatched listings. You can price several items at once, compare products side by side, compare prices across eight eBay marketplaces (US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Canada and Australia), check current eBay asking prices, and look up Mercari US listings. Useful for sourcing inventory, valuing a collection, or pricing an item to sell. Requires a CompSniper account; each search uses one search from your monthly CompSniper quota.

name: compsniper

positive.description: Price a used item from real eBay sold listings, with accessories removed
positive.prompt: What does a used Shure SM7B sell for on eBay? Remove accessories and irrelevant listings.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_price_summary (or search_sold_comps) for 'Shure SM7B' with itemCondition used and returns the median sold price, a realistic price range and the number of sales, with accessory-only listings excluded.

positive.description: Check whether a purchase price leaves room for a resale profit
positive.prompt: I can buy an iPhone 15 Pro 256GB for $620. What have they actually sold for on eBay lately, and is that a good flip?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves recent eBay sold prices for an iPhone 15 Pro 256GB, reports the median and range, and compares them with the $620 purchase price to explain the likely margin.

positive.description: Compare sold prices for several products at once
positive.prompt: Compare recent eBay sold prices for a Steam Deck OLED, Nintendo Switch OLED, and ASUS ROG Ally.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_products with the three products and presents each one's median sold price, range and sample size side by side.

positive.description: Compare one product across eBay marketplaces
positive.prompt: How do iPhone 15 Pro sold prices compare on eBay US, UK and Germany?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_marketplaces for 'iPhone 15 Pro' on ebay.com, ebay.co.uk and ebay.de and shows each marketplace's median sold price in its own currency.

positive.description: Show recent sold listings for an item
positive.prompt: Show me the 10 most recent eBay sold listings for a Sony WH-1000XM5 with their prices and sale dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_sold_comps for 'Sony WH-1000XM5' and lists recent sold listings with sold price, condition, sale date and link.

negative.description: General writing request unrelated to marketplace prices
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.

negative.description: Weather question unrelated to resale pricing
negative.prompt: What's the weather like in Paris today?

negative.description: Coding help unrelated to marketplace data
negative.prompt: How do I reverse a list in Python?
